need.query: Equip Context AI and a React/Vite/Fastify product with evidence-bound skills, design critique, accessibility and browser verification.
constraints: No autonomous candidate installation or execution.
Resolve exact artifact redistribution rights before copying.

claims.text: A skill packages instructions in SKILL.md and can link supporting references for progressive disclosure.
Codex discovers repository AGENTS.md guidance with scoped precedence; repository instructions are distinct from on-demand skills.
Impeccable supplies shape, critique, audit and polish procedures, with browser iteration and deterministic design detectors.
Vercel packages React guidance covering waterfalls, bundle size, rendering and rerenders; its scope includes React and Next.js.
Playwright documents axe integration for automated accessibility checks and recommends supplementing scans with manual assessment.
WCAG 2.2 specifies testable accessibility criteria, including keyboard access, visible focus and responsive reflow.
Core Web Vitals comprise LCP, INP and CLS; good field targets are 2.5 seconds, 200 milliseconds and 0.1 at the 75th percentile.
Anthropic publishes a frontend-design skill as a concise aesthetic reference for intentional interface work.
Codex configuration separates model selection and reasoning settings from repository instruction files.
The repository context:pack command completed on the current checkout and produced a bounded secret-scanned source map.

The built Signals Exchange was inspected at desktop and 320-pixel widths; the sampled pages had no axe violations or horizontal overflow, and its browser regression completed import, review, exact download, readiness, feedback and reassessment.

The archived Context importer accepted the exact early Signals bundle with ten recommendations and no activation; the consumer reports instruction reads and bounded browser checks while keeping the old active pin unchanged.

candidates.name: Agent Skills specification
candidates.reason: Use the specification as the procedure packaging contract.
limitations: Provider discovery behavior must be checked separately.

candidates.name: Codex repository instructions
candidates.reason: Use a short repository entry point and explicitly read relevant procedures.
limitations: Reading guidance does not prove runtime discovery or hook activation.

candidates.name: Impeccable design workflow
candidates.reason: Trial relevant instructions on the existing React product; retain Apache-2.0 attribution and notices if copied. The scoped Signals browser observation supports continued use of relevant instructions and checks, without causal or comparative benefit proof.
limitations: No measured comparative aesthetic benefit; optional binaries and hooks have not been executed.

candidates.name: Vercel React guidance
candidates.reason: Read stack-relevant MIT-licensed skill rules for React/Vite; skip Next.js server guidance. The scoped Signals browser observation supports continued use of relevant instructions and checks, without causal or comparative benefit proof.
limitations: The inspected skill frontmatter declares MIT; no measured comparative performance benefit.

candidates.name: Playwright accessibility testing
candidates.reason: Reuse existing pinned Playwright and axe dependencies with keyboard and screenshot review. The scoped Signals browser observation supports continued use of relevant instructions and checks, without causal or comparative benefit proof.
limitations: Automated success does not establish full accessibility conformance.

candidates.name: WCAG 2.2
candidates.reason: Use applicable AA criteria as the interaction review reference.
limitations: This source is a standard, not evidence that Signals conforms.

candidates.name: Core Web Vitals
candidates.reason: Keep field measurements separate from local build/browser proxies.
limitations: Signals has no field page-load data; local scores cannot certify deployed performance.

candidates.name: Anthropic frontend design reference
candidates.reason: Use as a fallback reference; the inspected artifact carries Apache-2.0 terms.
limitations: No copied assets or measured superiority.

candidates.name: Codex model configuration
candidates.reason: Treat configured client/model settings as runtime bindings, never as a side effect of reading Markdown.
limitations: No availability or price claim; this research did not change the active model.

candidates.name: Signals repository context pack
candidates.reason: Reuse the existing map and reopen source files before editing.
limitations: One builder observation proves command operation, not token savings or improved research quality.
Agent acquired and summarized primary sources; no configured local model ran.
Small selected web/context set, not an exhaustive landscape or universal best claim.
First-party claims establish documented interfaces, not independent benefit.

Browser results are builder observations, and consumer instruction-use feedback is self-reported local evidence. Neither is independent validation, configured model research, field performance or proof of design causality.
